annotations.title: Check a set of Etsy tags

description: Checks a tag set against Etsy's tag rules (up to 13 tags, up to 20 characters each, allowed characters) and flags duplicates, tags with the same words in another order, single-word tags and tags that repeat the title (pass the title for that). Returns one verdict. No search volume: Etsy shows search counts only to each seller, in Marketplace Insights.

tags.description: The tags, as an array or a comma-separated string
